reasoning: According to the Cambridge Bitcoin Electricity Consumption Index (CBECI) maintained by the Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance, Bitcoin's annualized electricity consumption is estimated to be between 120 and 160 Terawatt-hours (TWh). This exceeds the annual electricity consumption of several mid-sized countries, including Argentina, which consumes approximately 125 to 130 TWh per year. Multiple reputable news and research organizations have verified this comparison using official energy statistics and the CBECI tool.
